title: Control: a map with record values, including a key that contains the separator
rationale: The good-input drill for the map path, built so it can fail: the key hum_pct contains the default separator, so it exercises escapeSegment on a MAP KEY in the data path and decodeSegments on the way back. If escaping regresses, the key splits into two path levels and the reconstructed map gains spurious nesting.
catchesBugClass: Regression in map-key escaping or in map reconstruction. Specifically catches a map key being split on an embedded separator, and the MAP branch being misrouted to reconstructRecord.
cannotCatch: An empty map is not exercised and behaves completely differently depending on nullability - the same source value gets two answers. It also cannot catch a map key colliding with a sibling record field name, or a logical type on the map value type.

predicted.detail: Both keys escape and decode correctly. The result is a HashMap where the input was a LinkedHashMap, but Avro maps are unordered and key insertion order is genuinely not part of the value here.
